thread:
Kai (Design): Quick check on the invite drawer mock. Moving the SSO status from header into a tiny pill next to each role to help scanning. Concern: pill contrast + disabled CTA copy. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/s/invite-ssopill.png :camera:

Rowan (Frontend): Implementation notes: pills will be buttons for keyboard focus with aria-pressed when actionable. If org SSO is enforced, make pills non-interactive and add aria-disabled. Also will ensure initial focus lands on email field then role group; avoid trapping on container.

Dee (A11y): Accessibility: color only isn't enough. Add an explicit text node "SSO enforced" for screen readers and visible microcopy for sighted users. Pill color must meet 4.5:1 contrast; suggest using darker fill. Add aria-live polite region for async enforcement checks so status changes are announced.

Maya (PM): Copy decision: primary CTA stays 'Invite'. When SSO is enforced, show microcopy under CTA: 'SSO will be required for invited users.' If user tries to toggle per-role SSO while org enforcement is on, show a small inline notice: 'Cannot override org SSO.' Keep the notice inline, not modal.

Kai (Design): I'll update mocks to use filled dark blue pill and a 1-line helper under CTA with a 'Learn more' link. Will keep the per-role pill visually subtle but accessible.

Rowan (Frontend): I'll add aria-describedby on submit button to reference the microcopy and wire up focus return after drawer closes. Also will add unit tests for focus order and aria-describedby presence.

Dee (A11y): Please test with NVDA and VoiceOver. Ensure Esc closes drawer and that focus returns to the trigger. Check that the inline notice is programmatically associated with the toggle using aria-describedby when shown.

Deploy Bot: preview:invite-ssopill built  https://staging.redwood/preview/invite-ssopill (sha: mno321) :white_check_mark:

Rowan (Frontend): Ran axe on preview: issues: pill contrast still low on hover state, missing aria-label on small 'i' info buttons. Will patch and repush.
